title: Why it sucks being an Anderlecht fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being an... Anderlecht fan!
It starts when you're six. Your dad says: "We're the biggest club in Belgium. 34 titles!" You believe him.
Age eight. You finish third. Your dad calls it... a national emergency.
Age ten. No European football. For the first time in over fifty years. Your dad doesn't leave the house.
Age eleven. A club legend comes back. As captain... and manager. He picks himself. Obviously.
Age fourteen. Cup final against Gent. Penalties. You lose. Somewhere, a Gent fan gets called a Genk fan. Small comfort.
Age seventeen. Union, the small club from your own city... wins the league. Your dad says: "Who?"
That's the thing about being an Anderlecht fan. Your history is huge. Your recent trophy cabinet... is dusty.
But you're still the biggest club in Belgium. Your dad checks every morning.
Tag an Anderlecht fan. Purple forever. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
